topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I thought I was doing right by you, sneaking around the edges, trying to weave a brighter tapestry. It was meant as a gift, a way to see your eyes light up with pride. I spun tales of grand halls and important tasks, when the truth was more threadbare, more about simple days and quiet victories. I just wanted to give you something to believe in, a version of me that soared higher than the real. It wasn’t enough, so I added threads, borrowed colors. Now, seeing the holes, the rough patches, I fear I’ve only pulled us both into a tangled mess.
